content.text: The assignment provisions fully match our preferred position.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation, or transfer by change of control to consent not unreasonably withheld and bars assignment to a Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13.3 aligns licence transfer with permitted assignments. No change-of-control trigger elsewhere in the document. Favourable to us — no redline.
